identificationModule.briefTitle: A Phase II Study of Tislelizumab Plus Anlotinib Consolidation After Chemoradiotherapy in LS-SCLC
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Prospective, Single-Arm, Phase II Study of Tislelizumab Plus Anlotinib as Consolidation Therapy in Patients With Limited-Stage Small Cell Lung Cancer Without Progression After Concurrent or Sequential Chemoradiotherapy

collaborators.name: Chia Tai Tianqing Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd.

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This prospective, single-arm, phase II study aims to evaluate the efficacy and safety of tislelizumab plus anlotinib as consolidation therapy in patients with limited-stage small cell lung cancer (LS-SCLC) who have not progressed following concurrent or sequential chemoradiotherapy.

interventions.name: Tislelizumab + Anlotinib
interventions.description: Tislelizumab 200 mg on Day 1 plus anlotinib 10 mg on Days 1-14 of each 3-week cycle.
